name: assisted standing triceps extension (with towel)
instructions: Stand with a towel held overhead. Bend your elbows and lower the towel behind your head, then extend your arms to return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: assisted triceps dip (kneeling)
instructions: Kneel on the pad of the assisted dip machine. Grasp the handles and lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: band alternating biceps curl
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with both hands and curl one arm at a time towards your shoulder. Lower and repeat with the other arm.

name: band close-grip push-up
instructions: Wrap a resistance band around your back and hold the ends in your hands. Perform a push-up with your hands close together. Lower your body and push back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: band concentration curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and secure a resistance band under your foot. Grasp the band with one hand and curl it towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow stationary. Lower and repeat with the other arm.

name: band one arm overhead biceps curl
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with one hand and curl it overhead, keeping your elbow close to your head. Lower and repeat with the other arm.

name: band side triceps extension
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with one hand and extend your arm to the side, keeping your elbow stationary. Lower and repeat with the other arm.

name: barbell alternate biceps curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip. Curl one arm at a time towards your shoulder. Lower and repeat with the other arm.

name: barbell biceps curl (with arm blaster)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, using an arm blaster to keep your elbows stationary. Curl the barbell towards your shoulders. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell close-grip bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell to your chest, then push it back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip. Curl the barbell towards your shoulders. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell decline close grip to skull press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell to your forehead, then push it back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell drag curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip. Drag the barbell up your body, keeping your elbows back. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell incline close grip bench press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell to your chest, then push it back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell incline reverse-grip press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold a barbell with a reverse grip. Lower the barbell to your chest, then push it back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell jm bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell to your chest, then push it back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell lying back of the head tricep extension
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell behind your head, then extend your arms to return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell lying close-grip press
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell to your chest, then push it back up to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell lying close-grip triceps extension
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell to your forehead, then extend your arms to return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: barbell lying extension
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell to your forehead, then extend your arms to return to the starting position. Repeat.
